reviews_captured_by_me.text: Me and my husband hired Matt and his crew to put down the flooring for our home.  Not only did they do an amazing job,  was done before he even told us he would be, but they made sure to clean up all of the trash and make sure the floors were nice and clean and the extra flooring and other items they didn’t use was stacked neatly out of the way so that we could immediately move our furniture back like we had it.  If you need anything done, please don’t hesitate to call him!!
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 3 months ago
Thank you so much for the thoughtful review! We truly appreciate you trusting us with your flooring and are so glad you were happy with the work, cleanup, and overall experience. Your recommendation means a lot!

reviews_captured_by_me.text:
I really wish I could give more than a 5 star rating for Matt's Home Solutions! Matt & his crew made our remodel a complete breeze.
Matt made my visions for our Kitchen come true from the counter tops to the flooring to the backsplash! Our kitchen was a complete remodel from the floors up and I kept adding "extras" and Matt never complained he done everything we asked and his crew
are polite,hard working,professional and great to work with! I will use Matt's services again! We had him remodel our kitchen,put down flooring in other rooms,tear down our back deck,subfloor and joist replacement in the kitchen and so much more and my Husband & I are pleased with every service we received with Matt's Home Solutions! They are a great group of guys!

I attached "after" remodel pics below!
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 7 months ago
Thank you so much for the kind words. That truly means a lot to me and the guys.
We take a lot of pride in our work, but more than that, we want people to feel comfortable and confident throughout the entire process. I’m glad we could make it a smooth experience for you and your home.
I never mind the “extras” — that just means we’re building it exactly the way you want it.
I appreciate your trust in us and look forward to helping you again anytime.
— Matt & the guys!

reviews_captured_by_me.text: Matt did a total bathroom remodel for us.  He truly went above and beyond to exceed our expectations.  We were so stressed because we only had one shower in our home so Matt did everything he could to ensure we were back at home showering in no time.  He and his crew were a blessing!  We are so grateful for his attention to detail, fair pricing, and professionalism.  It is easy to see that this company truly takes pride in what they do!  Thank you Matt!  We sincerely appreciate you and your team!  I wish I had a before photo but pictures just don’t do this project justice!
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner a year ago
It was a pleasure working with you, and I’m so glad we were able to get your bathroom finished quickly so you could get back to normal life. We know how stressful it can be when you're down to one shower, so we made it a priority. I truly appreciate you recognizing our team’s effort and attention to detail — we take a lot of pride in what we do. It means the world to know we made a difference. Thanks again for trusting us with your home!
